units: Men. 15ᵃ; Pes. 13ᵇ לחם ג׳ תודה the bread is an appendage of the thank-offering; Men. 80ᵃ לִגְלַל תודה.—בִּגְלַל in consequence of, on account of, v. next w.

senses.gloss: something rolled, rounded, ball, ordure, excrement, dung.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 3:3">B. Kam. III, 3</cite> <he>ההופך את הג׳</he> he who upturns (throws up) ordure into the street.—Pl. <he>גְּלָלִים</he>, <he>גְּלָלִין</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 153b:8">Sabb. 153ᵇ</cite> <he>להטיל ג׳</he> to cast excrements (of animals).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16:3">Lev. R. s. 16</cite>; <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:1">Esth. R. to III, 1</cite> <he>מה הג׳ הללו וכ׳</he> as the dung is repulsive.

senses.gloss: (with כְּלֵי) a material used for vessels, supposed to be baked ordure.
units: Men. 69ᵃ; 69ᵇ; a. fr. [Rashi to Sabb. l. c. expl. ג׳ = שייש, marble, to Men. l. c. = צפיעי בקר.]
